cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode
types=[{"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},{"name":"B","kind":"int","bits":8},
       {"name":"AliasB","kind":"alias","target":"B"}]
mods=[
 {"name":"f2","params":[["x","B"],["y","AliasB"]],"result":["o","Bool"],
  "requires":["and",["lt",["var","x"],["const","B",10]],["gt",["var","y"],["const","B",0]]]},
 {"name":"fnull","params":[["z","B"]],"result":["o","Bool"],"requires":None},
 {"name":"deep","params":[["w","B"]],"result":["o","Bool"],
  "requires":["eq",["var","w"],["const","B",3]]},
 {"name":"e","params":[["a","B"],["b","B"],["c","B"]],"result":["r","Bool"],"requires":None},
]
pipes=[{"target":"e","filter":"f2","bind":{"x":"a","y":"b"}},
       {"target":"e","filter":"f2","bind":{"x":"c","y":"c"}},
       {"target":"e","filter":"fnull","bind":{"z":"a"}},
       {"target":"fnull","filter":"deep","bind":{"w":"z"}},
       {"target":"e","filter":"deep","bind":{"w":"b"}}]
camp={"types":types,"modules":mods,"calls":[],"pipes":pipes,"entries":["e"],"machine":None,"runs":[]}
plan=kit.run(camp)["plans"][0]
print(json.dumps(plan))
m=mods[3]
def st(a,b,c,flag):
    return kit.encode(encode.build(types,m,{"a":a,"b":b,"c":c},True,flag)[0])
runs=[("all true, flag0 -> READY", st(3,3,3,0)),
      ("all true, flag1 -> INVALID", st(3,3,3,1)),
      ("a=4 (deep a fails) flag1 -> FILTERED", st(4,3,3,1)),
      ("b=0 (f2#1 fails) flag1 -> FILTERED", st(3,0,3,1)),
      ("c=20 (f2#2 fails) flag1 -> FILTERED", st(3,3,20,1)),
      ("a=20 (f2#1 fails) flag1 -> FILTERED", st(20,3,3,1))]
camp["runs"]=[{"entry":"e","ktest":k} for _,k in runs]
out=kit.run(camp)
for (label,_),rec in zip(runs,out["records"]): print("%-40s %s"%(label,rec["status"]))
print(json.dumps([c["inputs"] for c in out["corpus"]]))
PYEOF
